name: self-desktop
description: Lets a session read its own machine's desktop on Windows, read only: it lists the windows a person could see (program, rectangle, monitor, state, which is in front; a title only for Windows Terminal windows and the session's own), reads the session's own terminal window (its controls and its own pane's text), and captures that window to a local PNG. It never clicks, types, focuses, moves or closes anything. Off until you turn it on.

updateCheck.title: Update check
updateCheck.description: on: when a tool of this plugin is called and the last check is 30 minutes old, fetch this plugin's published plugin.json from GitHub (a plain GET of a public file) and say when a newer version is out. off: never check.

enabled.title: Read the desktop
enabled.description: off (the default): every tool answers that self-desktop is off, and nothing is read. on: desktop_windows lists the windows a person could see (a title only for Windows Terminal windows and this session's own), desktop_read reads this session's own terminal window and its own pane's text, and desktop_capture saves a picture of that window to a local file. Windows only. Read only: nothing is clicked, typed, focused, moved or closed.
